cases.translation: I have Kubanskaya vodka in my little suitcase.
cases.explain: «В» answering «где?» (location, not direction) requires the prepositional case: в чемоданчике.

cases.translation: But there is no dry grape wine.
cases.explain: The negative existential «нет» ('there isn't any') puts the thing that is missing into the genitive.

cases.sentence: Я пошел в ___, чтобы слить мое дерьмо в «Поцелуй».
cases.translation: I went into the carriage to pour my rubbish into a «Kiss».
cases.explain: «В» with motion towards a place (куда?) takes the accusative; вагон is inanimate, so its accusative looks like the nominative.

cases.sentence: А умный в коверкотовом пальто сидит напротив ___ и будит его.
cases.translation: And the clever one in the gabardine coat sits opposite the dull one and keeps waking him.
cases.explain: The preposition «напротив» ('opposite') always governs the genitive.

cases.sentence: Берет его за ___ и до отказа подтаскивает к себе.
cases.translation: He takes him by the button and drags him right up to himself.
cases.explain: «За» in the sense of grabbing hold of something takes the accusative: взять за пуговицу.

cases.translation: So it was stolen between Kuchino and the 43rd kilometre.
cases.explain: The preposition «между» ('between') governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: No, the grandson is a complete cretin.
cases.explain: With a zero copula in the present tense (the dash stands for 'is'), the predicate noun stays in the nominative.

cases.sentence: Оба вскочили немедленно и бросились ко ___.
cases.translation: Both of them jumped up at once and rushed over to me.
cases.explain: The preposition «к» / «ко» ('towards, up to') requires the dative, giving ко мне.

reading.ru: А теперь давайте подумаем с вами вместе: что бы мне сейчас выпить?
reading.question: What does Venichka invite the reader to think about with him?
reading.explain: He asks what combination he can still make out of the leftovers in his little suitcase.

reading.ru: Чтобы не так тошнило от всех этих «Поцелуев», к ним надо привыкнуть с детства.
reading.question: According to Venichka, how does one avoid being nauseated by all these «Kisses»?
options: You have to get used to them from childhood
You have to drink them warm
You have to mix them with beer
You have to drink them very slowly
reading.correct: You have to get used to them from childhood
reading.explain: He jokes that a childhood habit is the only defence against the taste of his cocktails.

reading.question: Why can Venichka only dream about the «Первый поцелуй»?
options: He has no dry grape wine
He has no bottle to mix it in
reading.correct: He has no dry grape wine
reading.explain: The cocktail needs dry wine plus vodka, and he has the Kubanskaya but not the wine.

reading.question: Which drink does Venichka finally settle on?
reading.explain: It is the only mixture his remaining Rossiyskaya and pink fortified wine will make.

reading.question: What does Venichka find is missing when he comes back to his seat?
options: His bottle of pink fortified wine
reading.explain: The quarter-bottle he had only half finished at Serp i Molot has vanished from beside the suitcase.

reading.question: What did Venichka discover when he looked inside the little suitcase?
options: Everything in it was still there
Someone had left money in it
reading.correct: Everything in it was still there
reading.explain: Only the open quarter-bottle standing outside the suitcase had disappeared.

reading.ru: Значит, украли между Кучино и 43-м километром.
reading.question: When does Venichka work out that the theft must have taken place?
options: Between Moscow and Serp i Molot
While he was asleep at Nikolskoye
reading.explain: He reckons the angels stopped watching the suitcase around Kuchino, so the bottle went after that.

reading.ru: Я обвел глазами всех – ни один не сморгнул.
reading.question: How did the other passengers react when Venichka looked round at them all?
options: Not one of them so much as blinked
reading.correct: Not one of them so much as blinked
reading.explain: Their unblinking stare only confirms his sense that he is in love and out of his mind.

reading.question: What genre does Venichka say his journey is turning into now?
reading.explain: Up to now it had been essays, memoirs and poems in prose; the theft turns it into detective fiction.

reading.ru: Тупой в телогрейке уже давно закосел и спит.
reading.question: What is the dull one in the quilted jacket doing?
options: He has long been drunk and is asleep
He is arguing with the clever one
He is staring at Venichka's suitcase
He is standing by the window
reading.correct: He has long been drunk and is asleep
reading.explain: The clever one in the gabardine coat keeps pulling him by the button to wake him.

reading.ru: Нет, эти двое украсть не могли.
reading.question: What does Venichka conclude about the dull one and the clever one?
options: Neither of them could have stolen it
Both of them stole it together
The one in the gabardine coat stole it
reading.correct: Neither of them could have stolen it
reading.explain: By his mock-logic one of them is asleep and the other wears a gabardine coat, so neither is capable of theft.

reading.ru: Очень странные люди эти двое: он и она.
reading.question: What is odd about the man and the woman sitting behind Venichka?
options: They are strangers to each other yet look exactly alike
They are asleep on each other's shoulders
They are quarrelling loudly about a ticket
They are dressed as railway staff
reading.correct: They are strangers to each other yet look exactly alike
reading.explain: Both wear a jacket, a brown beret and a moustache, though they sit at opposite windows and clearly do not know each other.

reading.ru: Внучек на две головы длиннее дедушки и от рождения слабоумен.
reading.question: How does Venichka describe the grandson sitting ahead of him?
options: Two heads taller than the grandfather and feeble-minded from birth
Two heads shorter than the grandfather but very clever
Exactly the same height as the grandfather
A small boy asleep on the grandfather's knees
reading.correct: Two heads taller than the grandfather and feeble-minded from birth
reading.explain: The grandfather is two heads shorter, and Venichka adds that he is feeble-minded as well.

reading.question: What behaviour makes Venichka suspect the grandfather and the grandson?
options: They keep licking their lips while staring at him
They keep whispering to each other
reading.correct: They keep licking their lips while staring at him
reading.explain: Everyone stares at him, but only these two lick their lips, which he finds very suspicious.

reading.ru: Оба сели, в упор рассматривая мой чемоданчик.
reading.question: What did the pair do once Venichka invited them to sit opposite him?
options: They sat down and stared point-blank at his little suitcase
They refused and went back to their seats
They immediately asked him for a drink
reading.correct: They sat down and stared point-blank at his little suitcase
reading.explain: The suitcase is what interests them, and the grandson even sits sideways on his left rib.

reading.ru: Как звать тебя, папаша, и куда ты едешь?
reading.question: What does Venichka ask the grandfather at the end of the chapter?
options: His name and where he is travelling to
Whether he has seen the missing bottle
Whether he has anything to drink
How he is related to the grandson
reading.correct: His name and where he is travelling to
reading.explain: The chapter closes on this first question of his interrogation of the two suspects.

highlight.question: Which sentence says how much vodka was still left in the missing quarter-bottle?
sentences: Подошел – и остолбенел.
Где моя четвертинка российской?
Та самая четвертинка, которую я у Серпа и Молота только ополовинил?
От самого Серпа и Молота она стояла у чемоданчика, в ней оставалось почти сто грамм – где же она теперь?
highlight.explain: The last sentence says that almost a hundred grams were left in it when it stood by the suitcase.

highlight.question: Which sentence describes how the clever one wakes the sleeping man up?
sentences: Я взглянул вправо: там все до сих пор сидят эти двое, тупой-тупой и умный-умный.
Тупой в телогрейке уже давно закосел и спит.
А умный в коверкотовом пальто сидит напротив тупого и будит его.

И как-то по-живодерски будит: берет его за пуговицу и до отказа подтаскивает к себе, как бы натягивая тетиву, – а потом отпускает: и тупой-тупой в телогрейке летит на прежнее место, вонзаясь в спинку лавочки, как в сердце тупая стрела Амура…
highlight.explain: The fourth sentence gives the method: pulling him by the button like a bowstring and letting go.

highlight.question: Which sentence lists the clothes that make the man and the woman look alike?
sentences: Я глянул назад – нет, там тоже нет ничего такого, что могло бы натолкнуть на мысль.
Двое, правда, наталкивают на мысль, но совсем не на ту.
Очень странные люди эти двое: он и она.
Они сидят по разным сторонам вагона, у противоположных окон, и явно незнакомы друг с другом.
Но при всем том – до странности похожи: он в жакетке, и она – в жакетке; он в коричневом берете и при усах, и она – при усах и в коричневом берете…
highlight.explain: The final sentence itemises the jackets, the moustaches and the brown berets.

highlight.question: Which sentence tells us that the grandfather is feeble-minded too?
sentences: И впереди то же самое, странных только двое: дедушка и внучек.
Внучек на две головы длиннее дедушки и от рождения слабоумен.
Дедушка – на две головы короче, но слабоумен тоже.
Оба глядят мне прямо в глаза и облизываются…
highlight.explain: The third sentence adds that the shorter grandfather shares the grandson's condition.

highlight.question: Which sentence describes the grandson's back-to-front way of breathing?
sentences: Нет, внучек – совершенный кретин.
У него и шея-то не как у всех, у него шея не врастает в торс, а как-то вырастает из него, вздымаясь к затылку вместе с ключицами.
И дышит он как-то идиотически: вначале у него выдох, а потом вдох, тогда как у всех людей наоборот: сначала вдох, а уж потом выдох.
И смотрит на меня, смотрит, разинув глаза и сощурив рот…
highlight.explain: The third sentence explains that he breathes out first and only then breathes in.

highlight.question: Which sentence explains exactly how the grandson's way of sitting differs from everyone else's?
sentences: Оба сели, в упор рассматривая мой чемоданчик.
Внучек сел как-то странно.
Мы все садимся на задницу, а этот сел как-то странно: избоченясь, на левое ребро, и как бы предлагая одну свою ногу мне, а другую – дедушке.
highlight.explain: Only the third sentence spells out that he sits sideways on his left rib instead of on his backside.
